title: A model-health endpoint for the API
summary:
Thirteen community apps joined the catalog, while the API gained model-health data and fixes for text and image requests.

A community contribution added `GET /v1/models/status` for raw model-health data. Its `minutes` parameter accepts 1–1440 for the lookback window; responses are cached for 60 seconds, with cached data available if the upstream request fails.

A community fix strips `reasoning_effort` before requests reach seven models that do not support it, preventing unsupported-parameter errors without changing reasoning-capable models. A team fix changed the routing for `gptimage` and `gptimage-large` after image requests hit errors.

The app catalog added Imagipedia and PolliArt Studio for image creation, Storiva and BeDream APP for stories and writing, Textylize for text styling, Generative Soundscape for music, and PolliCross for image-based puzzles. Plenty to make with a prompt; not all of it needs to be a chatbot.

highlights.title: Query model health
highlights.text: Get raw model-health data from `GET /v1/models/status`. Set `minutes` from 1 to 1440 to choose the lookback window. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
